profile.org_note: FY2025 10-K reports three segments: Builder operations Central (Texas), Builder operations Southeast (Georgia and Florida) and Land Development; there are no regional presidents, so each builder brand's president runs its market and the Texas region post Jed Dolson held from 2017 has not been refilled. Land is centralised under EVP of Land Bobby Samuel (contractually reports to the CEO) across all builders, with a land committee and the Co-CEOs (Dolson, ex-head of land; Brickman, capital allocation) making the final call; CFO Jeff Cox runs finance and treasury.
profile.summary: Plano, Texas public builder (NYSE: GRBK), third-largest in Dallas-Fort Worth, with seven builder brands in Texas (DFW, Austin, Houston), Atlanta and Florida's Treasure Coast; about 3,900 closings a year. It is the opposite of land-light: it owns and self-develops most of its land (40,869 lots owned and 10,566 under contract at 2026-09-30, roughly 79% owned) and says this locks in lot cost; leverage is very low (homebuilding debt to capital 13.1%). Jed Dolson, the former head of land, became Co-CEO alongside founder Jim Brickman on 2026-10-15.

people.name: Bobby L. Samuel III
people.title: Executive Vice President of Land
people.prior_role: National Vice President of Land, Green Brick (joined 2018); earlier VP of Land for the DFW division of a large public homebuilder; licensed Texas professional engineer
people.source_title: Green Brick Partners leadership page (live); reporting line from Samuel employment agreement, Exhibit 10.51
people.note: Named executive officer. Company says he oversees land acquisition AND land development for Green Brick and all subsidiary builders, i.e. he effectively leads the Land Development reportable segment (segment-leader link is inferred from his remit). His employment agreement (effective 2025-05-12, filed as Exhibit 10.51) says he reports directly to the CEO, then Jim Brickman; since 2026-10-15 the CEO office is shared with Jed Dolson, so he may now answer to either Co-CEO. Confirmed in the 2026 proxy (filed 2026-05-22) and quoted as EVP of Land in a January 2026 company release. Promotion from National VP of Land announced 2025-03-20.

people.name: Jed Dolson
people.title: Co-Chief Executive Officer and Director
people.prior_role: President and Chief Operating Officer (Oct 2023 to Oct 2026); EVP and COO (2020 to 2023); President of Trophy Signature Homes (2022 to 2024); President of Texas Region (from 2017); Head of Land Acquisition and Development (from 2013)
people.note: The land decision-maker at the top: came up as head of land acquisition and development and, as COO, led all builder and land functions. Promoted to Co-CEO as part of stated succession planning; appointed to the board 2026-10-22 (8-K filed 2026-10-26), board expanded to seven. Civil engineer by training. Leadership page lists him as 'Co-CEO & Director'.

people.name: Jeffery D. Cox
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.prior_role: Interim CFO (March 2025 to Oct 2025); SVP of Finance, Green Brick (joined June 2023); Regional VP of Finance, Richmond American Homes (2020 to 2023); Division Controller, Lennar (2016 to 2020)
people.note: Signs the company's 8-Ks as CFO through 2026-10-26. Led the launch of Green Brick Mortgage and oversees Green Brick Title. Succeeded Richard A. Costello, who resigned effective 2025-03-17. No separate treasurer is published, so treasury and capital markets appear to sit with him. Reporting line inferred (CFO to the CEO/Co-CEOs), not stated.
